name: Band Good Morning
steps: Stand on a long band with feet hip width apart.
Loop the top of the band behind your neck and hold it at your shoulders.
Soften your knees and push your hips back to bow forward.
Stop at a hamstring stretch with your back flat.
Drive hips forward to stand tall against the band.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you rise

common_mistakes.fix: Bow only as far as your back stays flat
Hold the band at your shoulders with your hands
